ValidationRule.description: Prevents non-admins from editing Household, Type or Classification on Business, Retirement Plan, Trust, and Person Account records when Type is Active Client or Former Client.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Business", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Retirement_Plan", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Trust", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PersonAccount" ), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Type), "Former Client"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Type), "Active Client") ), OR( ISCHANGED(Type), ISCHANGED(Classification__c), ISCHANGED(Household__c) ), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To request an update to this field please contact the Ops team or submit an envelope for the change request.
